payload.title: [HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-003] Align execution detail APIs with errors payload and masking
payload.body:
## Summary

Ensure authenticated **GET** execution-detail JSON responses expose **`execution.errors`** consistently with the database for **schedule**, **HTTP trigger**, and **manual** executions, and apply **`maskSecretsInJson`** (or equivalent) to the `errors` blob if entries could embed substituted secrets—without exposing new unauthenticated surfaces.

## Scope

- In scope: `apps/hermes/dashboard/app/api/...` routes that return execution detail; `maskScheduleExecutionDetailForDisplay` (and parallel mask helpers for HTTP/manual) if they omit or should sanitize `errors`.
- Out of scope: Public or `NEXT_PUBLIC` exposure of stack traces.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] For each execution source, **GET** detail returns `execution.errors` with the same semantics as the server component loaders (bit-for-bit equality not required, but no accidental omission of `errors`).
- [ ] If error JSON may contain sensitive key paths, `errors` is passed through the project’s JSON secret masking before the response body (REQ-003/PRD §5 masking) — document the decision in the PR if no masking is needed because shape guarantees no secrets.
- [ ] No new routes without dashboard session auth (REQ-004).
- [ ] Tests: route handler or serialization tests assert `errors` round-trip for at least one fixture per source (or documented manual QA checklist **plus** schedule automated test where patterns already exist).

## Dependencies

- Depends on: none (can run parallel with `HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-002`; coordinate masking with `HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-001` if error text references config)
- Blocks: none

## Notes

- PRD: schedule data layer already selects `errors`; verify HTTP trigger and manual detail routes mirror that.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/hermes-enqueue-failure-diagnostics.prd.md
